outfit.name: 漆黑异端·侵蚀灰姑娘战斗装
outfit.prose: Anachiro the Corrupted Heretic combat attire: sharp angular obsidian-black and blood-crimson crystal armor plating clinging to her graceful silhouette, ragged shadowy translucent cape trailing behind her, jagged dark crystal high-heels, and glowing crimson crystalline shards hovering at her back.
